activities.reference:
def failure_percent(total,failed):
    return failed/total*100
def main():
    target=input().strip().lower()
    total=int(input())
    failed=int(input())
    print(f"Target: {target}")
    print(f"Total: {total}")
    print(f"Failed: {failed}")
    print(f"Failure rate: {failure_percent(total,failed):.2f}%")
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

tests.harness:
import ast,math
assert callable(globals().get('failure_percent')), 'Define failure_percent(total, failed).'
assert math.isclose(failure_percent(4,1),25), 'Return the calculated percentage.'
assert callable(globals().get('main')), 'Define main().'
tree=ast.parse(_academy_source)
def guard(node):
    if not isinstance(node,ast.If) or not isinstance(node.test,ast.Compare) or len(node.test.ops)!=1 or not isinstance(node.test.ops[0],ast.Eq):
        return False
    values=[node.test.left,*node.test.comparators]
    return any(isinstance(v,ast.Name) and v.id=='__name__' for v in values) and any(isinstance(v,ast.Constant) and v.value=='__main__' for v in values)
assert any(guard(n) for n in tree.body), 'Use the standard main guard.'
